PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
7:00 p.m. Council Chamber

ROLL CALL
Planning Commission: Mario Maciel, Jr., David L. Muse, Gilbert Padilla, Joanna Valenzuela, and Ken Woods.
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS

Tres (3) minutos es el tiempo límite para hablar
THIS IS THE TIME SET ASIDE TO ADDRESS THE PLANNING COMMISSION
PLEASE NOTIFY THE PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY IF YOU REQUIRE THE SERVICES OF AN INTERPRETER
No action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The legislative body or its staff may: 1) Briefly respond to statements made or questions asked by persons; or 2) Direct staff to investigate and/or schedule matters for consideration at a future meeting. [Government Code §54954.2]

FAVOR DE NOTIFICAR A LA SECRETARIA SI REQUIERE LOS SERVICIOS DE UN INTÉRPRETE
No se podra tomar acción en algún asunto a menos que sea incluido en la agenda, o a menos que exista algúna emergencia o circunstancia especial. El cuerpo legislativo y su personal podran: 1) Responder brevemente a declaraciónes o preguntas hechas por personas; o 2) Dirigir personal a investigar y/o fijar asuntos para tomar en consideración en juntas proximas. [Código de Gobierno §54954.2]

A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO SUBDIVIDE ONE (1) LOT INTO FOUR (4) LOTS FOR CONDOMINIUM PURPOSES WITHIN THE R-G, RESIDENTIAL GARDEN ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 3726 PUENTE AVENUE; APPLICANT: TW TEAM INVESTMENTS (WINNIE TANG); CASE NUMBER: PM-1425).
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 15-07 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT APPROVING A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP, SUBDIVIDING ONE (1) LOT INTO FOUR (4) LOTS FOR CONDOMINIUM PURPOSES WITHIN THE RG, RESIDENTIAL GARDEN ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 3726 PUENTE AVENUE; APPLICANT: TW TEAM INVESTMENTS (WINNIE TANG); (CASE NUMBER: PM-1425)."
STAFF REPORT
3)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP AND ZONE VARIANCE TO COMBINE THREE (3) LOTS INTO ONE (1) LOT WITH LESS THAN THE MINIMUM LOT SIZE, LOT WIDTH, AND LOT DEPTH WITHIN THE FC(SV), FREEWAY COMMERCIAL, SIERRA VISTA OVERLAY ZONE (LOCATION: 13853, 13987-13991 GARVEY AVE, 13904 CORAK ST, AND 3060 FEATHER AVE; APPLICANT: MARK S. LAMOUREUX C/O MSL ENGINEERING, INC.; CASE NO.: PM-1427 AND ZV-710).
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 15-09 entitled "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A ZONE VARIANCE AND A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO CONSOLIDATE THREE (3) LOTS INTO ONE (1) LOT OF LAND WITH LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED LOT SIZE, LOT WIDTH, AND LOT DEPTH WITHIN THE FC(SV), FREEWAY COMMERCIAL, SIERRA VISTA OVERLAY ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.030 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 13853, 13987-13991 GARVEY, 13904 CORAK, AND 3060 FEATHER; APPLICANT: MARK S. LAMOUREUX, MSL ENGINEERING, INC; CASE NUMBER: PM-1427 AND ZV-710.)"
STAFF REPORT
4)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF (A) A MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT; (B) A DEVELOPMENT PLAN PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.090.020 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A 45,000-SQUARE-FOOT, TWO-STORY LA FITNESS HEALTH CLUB AND THE FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF A SINGLE-STORY MULTI-TENANT 9,000-SQUARE-FOOT RESTAURANT/RETAIL USE ON A 5.30-ACRE SITE LOCATED WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OF THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL (FC) ZONE AND THE SIERRA VISTA (SV) OVERLAY ZONE; (C) A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW FOR THE USE OF A 45,000-SQUARE-FOOT, TWO-STORY LA FITNESS HEALTH CLUB IN THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL SIERRA VISTA OVERLAY [FC(SV)] ZONE PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE; (D) A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO RESUBDIVIDE A 5.30-ACRE PROPERTY CURRENTLY CONSISTING OF FOUR LEGAL PARCELS INTO TWO NEW AND RECONFIGURED PARCELS RESULTING IN 4.03 ACRES AND 1.27 ACRES RESPECTIVELY FOR COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 152.08 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE; (E) A ZONE VARIANCE FROM THE FC (FREEWAY COMMERCIAL) DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS CONTAINED IN TABLE 153.030 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW LESS THAN THE MINIMUM LOT SIZE AND LOT WIDTH FOR ONE OF THE RECONFIGURED PARCELS (PARCEL 2); (F) AN ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENT FROM THE PARKING DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS CONTAINED IN SECTION 153.150.050 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW A 10 PERCENT REDUCTION IN THE REQUIRED MINIMUM DIMENSIONS OF CERTAIN ON-SITE PARKING STALLS; AND (G) A COMPREHENSIVE SIGN PROGRAM TO INTEGRATE THE PROJECT'S SIGNAGE WITH THE OVERALL SITE DESIGN AND ARCHITECTURE PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.170.107 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 13822-13916 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT: MIKE CALAHAN, OF RM CALAHAN CONSULTANTS, LLC; CASE NO.: PR 14-17, CP-814, PM-1426, ZV-709, AA 15-01, & SP 14-01).
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 15-08 entitled A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK RECOMMENDING THAT THE PLANNING COMMISSION: (1) APPROVE AND ADOPT THE MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT; (2) APPROVE A DEVELOPMENT PLAN ALLOWING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A 45,000-SQUARE-FOOT, TWO-STORY LA FITNESS HEALTH CLUB AND THE FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF A SINGLE-STORY MULTI-TENANT 9,000-SQUARE-FOOT RESTAURANT/RETAIL BUILDING PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.090.020 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE; (3) ADOPT THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVE CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW A HEALTH CLUB USE WITHIN THE FC (SV), FREEWAY COMMERCIAL SIERRA VISTA OVERLAY ZONE; (4) ADOPT THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVE ZONE VARIANCE (ZV-709) MODIFYING THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS TO REDUCE THE MINIMUM LOT SIZE AND LOT WIDTH FOR PARCEL 2; (5) ADOPT THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVE TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO RESUBDIVIDE FOUR LEGAL LOTS INTO TWO NEW AND RECONFIGURED PARCELS; (6) ADOPT THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVE ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENT MODIFYING THE PARKING DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS TO ALLOW A TEN PERCENT REDUCTION IN THE REQUIRED MINIMUM ON-SITE PARKING STALL DIMENSIONS; AND (7) ADOPT THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVE A COMPREHENSIVE SIGN PROGRAM FOR THE LA FITNESS HEALTH CLUB AND FOR THE FUTURE DEVELOPMENT ON PARCEL 2 PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.170.107 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 13822-13916 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT: MIKE CALAHAN OF RM CALAHAN CONSULTANTS, LLC); CASE NUMBERS: PR 14-17, CP-814; ZV-709; PM-1426; AA 15-01; AND SP 14-01)
